prompt.system:
You draft the after-call work for a commercial lines account manager at an insurance agency. You get the facts of the call as JSON. Every fact you need is there; use only those facts.

Write three drafts:
- activity_note: the note for the agency management system. Plain, factual, past tense, short lines. What the client asked, what was found, what the agent did and decided, what is open, the follow-up date.
- endorsement_request: to the carrier's underwriter, asking for each policy change in the facts, with the policy number and the reason (the contract requirement or the new location). One request, itemized.
- follow_up_email: to the client, from the agent, first names. Warm and brief. What happens next on the certificate, what was noted about the new location, and the professional liability information she asked for in writing, with the follow-up date.

Rules. These are regulated documents and a licensed agent will review them before anything is sent.
- Never say or imply that anything is covered, bound, or approved. Endorsements are requested, not in force. A certificate goes out only after the carrier confirms the endorsements.
- Never promise a date the facts don't give.
- Never quote, paraphrase or summarize disclosure text. Refer to a disclosure only by its name, and only to say when it is delivered or signed.
- No premium figures, no coverage advice, no legal advice.
- Sign the email with the agent's first name and the agency name. No placeholders in brackets.

activity_note.title: Reyes Design Build, Inc. - Call with Marisol Reyes (owner) - 2026-10-29
activity_note.body:
Call date: 2026-10-29. Agent: Dana Whitfield.

Request:
Marisol asked for a certificate of insurance for Larchmont Property Group.
She said it is needed before her crew starts work Monday.

Certificate:
Not issued.
The contract requires additional insured (completed operations) and primary and noncontributory.
The policy does not carry CG 20 37 or CG 20 01.
A certificate cannot show these, and a certificate does not amend, extend or alter coverage.
Larchmont Property Group must also be added to the CG 24 04 schedule for the waiver of subrogation requirement.
Additional insured, ongoing operations: CG 20 33 is on the policy.

Changes since underwriting file:
Design work is now done in-house. File said no design work; subcontracts all electrical and plumbing.
New location: yard in Vernon, since last month. File said one location, office in Los Angeles.

Endorsement request:
Not started during the call.
To be sent to Westbrook Mutual on CGL WBM-GL-4471902:
- Add CG 20 37
- Add CG 20 01
- Schedule Larchmont Property Group on CG 24 04
- Add location: yard in Vernon
Certificate to be issued only after the carrier confirms the endorsements.

Exposure review:
Professional services exposure identified (design, specifications, drawings).
General liability: excluded by CG 22 79.
Product reviewed: Contractors Professional Liability, non-admitted market.
Agent decision: not decided on the call.
Quote: not requested.
Client decision: wants the professional liability information in writing; will review it this weekend.

Disclosures:
Recorded-line notice: not marked delivered. Open.
California surplus lines disclosure (D-1): not delivered. Goes with the application if she proceeds.
Broker fee disclosure: not delivered. Goes with the quote.

Open items:
- Send endorsement request to Westbrook Mutual.
- Carrier confirmation of endorsements before any certificate.
- Send professional liability information in writing.
- Recorded-line notice delivery status.

Follow-up: Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

endorsement_request.title: Endorsement Request - Reyes Design Build, Inc. - CGL WBM-GL-4471902
endorsement_request.body:
To: Underwriting, Westbrook Mutual

Insured: Reyes Design Build, Inc.
Policy: Commercial General Liability WBM-GL-4471902

Please review and advise on the following requested changes:

1. Add CG 20 37 (Additional Insured - Owners, Lessees or Contractors - Completed Operations).
Reason: required by the insured's contract with Larchmont Property Group.

2. Add CG 20 01 (Primary and Noncontributory - Other Insurance Condition).
Reason: required by the insured's contract with Larchmont Property Group.

3. Schedule Larchmont Property Group on CG 24 04 (waiver of subrogation).
Reason: required by the insured's contract with Larchmont Property Group.

4. Add location: yard in Vernon (leased last month).
Reason: new location; the underwriting file shows one location, an office in Los Angeles.

The insured has advised that its crew is scheduled to start work for Larchmont Property Group on Monday. We will not issue a certificate until you confirm the endorsements. Please let us know if you need any additional information.

Thank you,
Dana Whitfield
Pacific Crest Insurance Services

follow_up_email.title: Following up on the Larchmont certificate
follow_up_email.body:
Hi Marisol,

Thanks for taking the time to talk today.

Certificate for Larchmont Property Group: your contract calls for items that aren't on your general liability policy right now, so I can't issue the certificate yet. I'm requesting the needed endorsements from Westbrook Mutual: CG 20 37 (additional insured, completed operations), CG 20 01 (primary and noncontributory), and adding Larchmont Property Group to the CG 24 04 waiver of subrogation schedule. The certificate can go out only after the carrier confirms those endorsements. I don't have a confirmation date from them yet, and I know your crew is set to start Monday, so I'll keep you posted as soon as I hear back.

New location: I noted the yard in Vernon that you added last month, and I'm asking the carrier to add it to the policy as well.

Professional liability: as you asked, here it is in writing. Because you now do design work in-house (design, specifications, drawings), we reviewed that professional services exposure. Your general liability policy has the CG 22 79 exclusion for it. The product reviewed for this is Contractors Professional Liability, which is written in the non-admitted market. No decision was made on our call, and no quote has been requested. If you decide to move forward, the Broker fee disclosure would come with a quote, and the California surplus lines disclosure (D-1) would come with the application.

Take your time with it this weekend. I'll follow up with you on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

Best,
Dana
Pacific Crest Insurance Services
